name: 30° Manual Dive
summary: Fixed reticle, 30° dive, 450 kt, release by 4,500 ft

sight.notes: Mk-82 LD, 30° / 450 kt / 4,500 ft — check the Mirage F1 manual depression tables (§7.7) for the actual load

procedure: Sight in manual bombing mode, depression set, station selected
Roll in, establish 30° and 450 kt — hold them
Reticle on the target at release altitude: pickle, 4 G recovery
source: community practice (Aerges Mirage F1 manual depression tables, estimated)

name: 45° Manual Dive
summary: Fixed reticle, steep dive from 12,000 ft, release by 6,500 ft

sight.notes: Mk-82 LD, 45° / 450 kt / 6,500 ft — check the depression tables

procedure: Sight in manual bombing mode, depression set
Steep roll-in; throttle back to hold 450 kt
Reticle on at release altitude: pickle, 5 G recovery — do not press
source: community practice (Aerges Mirage F1 manual depression tables, estimated)

name: 30° Dive CCIP
summary: Computed impact point, 30° dive from 8,000 ft
procedure: Sight in CCIP bombing mode, station selected
Roll in, put the pipper short of the target and let it walk up
Pickle by release altitude, no lower — 4 G recovery

name: Laydown 500 ft (HD)
summary: Fast and low with retarded bombs or CBUs
procedure: Level at 500 ft, 480 kt — pickle as the target passes the reticle

name: Gun 10°
summary: Shallow gun pass, cease by 1,000 ft
procedure: Guns selected, sight in gun mode
Roll in, reticle on, short bursts
Cease fire at 1,000 ft and pull — never press a gun pass
